description: Dated steps for someone in Finland who has been given notice on economic grounds: registering as a job seeker, the window for workers aged 55 and over, and applying for the change-security allowance. Takes the notice date, age, employer size and either the last day of employment or years of service. The result cites the rules version and whether the rules are marked as verified. General information, not legal advice. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.
